en: Deleted tasks now have a permanent-delete action and a Clear deleted tasks button, with confirmation. Archived tasks can be moved to the deleted list. Permanent deletion removes Prism task records, attachments, task workspaces and drafts, and prevents older windows from restoring purged drafts. External project files and native CLI histories are retained.

Existing Codex sessions restore context readings from their own account-local history when opened, and support a read-only refresh without starting a model turn. Claude context readings now bind to the reported session before being saved. Unknown values remain unknown.
zh: 已删除任务新增“彻底删除”和“清空已删除”，确认后清除棱镜任务记录、附件、任务工作区和草稿，阻止旧窗口重新写回已清除草稿；已归档任务可移入已删除列表。外部项目文件及原生 CLI 历史保留。
打开已有 Codex 会话时，从对应账号的本机会话记录补读上下文，并支持不启动模型执行的刷新；Claude 用量数据先绑定返回的会话再保存，缺失数值仍显示未知。
